name: feature.computer-use.nodes
description: Computer-use browser-agent nodes (ADR 0418) over ctx.features['computer-use']: `task` starts/resumes a provider-hosted browser session and runs the risk-tiered loop until completion or a commit-class action halts it awaiting approval; compose core.approvalGate then `decide` to record the human verdict and resume; `status` reads the session. Fail-closed origin allowlist, per-tenant daily session budget, recorded trajectories (replay never re-drives a browser). role:action.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Computer Use: Run Task
nodes.description: Starts (or resumes — submit-once on identical inputs) a browser-agent session and advances the risk-tiered loop: observe/interact actions auto-approve and record; a commit-class action (submit/download/new-origin/credential) halts with state `awaiting_approval` for the approval-gate chain. Inputs: { orgId, task, startUrl, allowedOrigins[] (https, fail-closed) }. Output: { session: { sessionId, status, steps, pendingAction?, resultSummary?, error? } }.

nodes.label: Computer Use: Decide Pending Action
nodes.description: Records the human verdict on a session's pending commit-class action (compose AFTER core.approvalGate — this node trusts the recorded gate outcome) and resumes (approve) or ends the session (deny). Inputs: { sessionId, approve }. Output: { session }.

nodes.label: Computer Use: Session Status
nodes.description: Reads a session's recorded state (status, step count, pending action, result). Inputs: { sessionId }. Output: { session | null }. Tenant-guarded read.
